label: A von Bertalanffy grower stays strictly below its asymptotic length, and K alone sets the shape
statement_en: For a cohort whose length at age follows von Bertalanffy, length(t) = Linf*(1 - exp(-K*(t - t0))) with asymptotic length Linf > 0 and Brody coefficient K > 0 (a named hypothesis), length is strictly below Linf at every age, strictly increasing in age, and two cohorts sharing K reach the same fraction of their own asymptote at the same age measured from their own t0, however different their asymptotic lengths.

hypotheses.name: Delphi.LeanBio.Round2.GrowthAsymptote.GrowthHyp
hypotheses.statement: A cohort's length at age follows the von Bertalanffy curve length(t) = Linf*(1 - exp(-K*(t - t0))) with Linf > 0 and K > 0. The repo's default curve is FL_cm(t_yr) = 23.3*(1 - exp(-3.12*(t_yr - 0.01))) for Hirundichthys affinis off northwest Barbados; across the 12 FishBase rows in development/growth.json Linf runs 13.5 to 30.5 cm and K runs 0.86 to 3.65 per year. All 12 rows are kind 'secondary' (a FishBase compilation), not measurements made in this repo.
hypotheses.value: Linf = 23.3 cm FL, K = 3.12 /yr, t0 = 0.01 yr (default curve)
hypotheses.source: development/growth.json default_curve (FishBase growth row autoctr 4651, Main Ref 6829 = Oxenford HA, Hunte W, Deane R, Campana SE (1994) Otolith age validation and growth-rate variation in flyingfish (Hirundichthys affinis) from the eastern Caribbean. Mar Biol 118:585-592, doi:10.1007/BF00347505; the only row FishBase marks as validated, by laboratory rearing of larvae and mark-recapture of adults); development/sources.json oxenford-1994 records that the paper itself was not seen and the parameters come from the FishBase row

asymptotic_length.unit: cm (FL or TL as given per row)

scope.basis: 12 FishBase von Bertalanffy rows over 7 of the 75 Exocoetidae species, compiled in development/growth.json (built 2026-10-31); the default curve is the single row FishBase marks as validated. Field fits already embed the food and temperature of their locality (development/growth.json 'conditions' says nothing is adjusted for temperature or nutrition), so this is not a temperature-free law of growth. Nothing is established for the 68 species with no growth row, nor for embryos, for which no growth row exists. The theorem itself is taxon-free; the scope is the data the constants and the witness come from.

sources: development/growth.json (12 FishBase von Bertalanffy rows, 7 Exocoetidae species; default curve autoctr 4651)

browser_check.relation: SL < Linf  (a von Bertalanffy grower never reaches its own asymptotic length)
browser_check.note: Checks a design's standard length against the asymptotic length of the growth curve fitted to its own taxon. 'violated' means the design's length is impossible under that fitted curve; it does NOT mean the animal cannot be that long, because only 7 of 75 Exocoetidae species have a growth row and all 12 rows are a FishBase compilation (kind 'secondary') fitted in one locality and year. growth_Linf_m is not an engine state field today: it must be read from development/growth.json keyed by taxon, or declared by the design, and a design that supplies neither gets cannot-evaluate rather than a pass.

lean.source:
/-- **Von Bertalanffy growth.** Under `GrowthHyp`: length stays strictly below the asymptote at
every age, rises strictly with age, and -- for two cohorts sharing `K` -- the same age since `t0`
gives the same fraction of each cohort's own asymptote. -/
theorem von_bertalanffy_asymptote {Linf K t0 : ℝ} (h : GrowthHyp Linf K)
    {Linf' t0' : ℝ} (h' : GrowthHyp Linf' K) (f t : ℝ) :
    (∀ s : ℝ, vonB Linf K t0 s < Linf) ∧
    (∀ s u : ℝ, s < u → vonB Linf K t0 s < vonB Linf K t0 u) ∧
    (vonB Linf K t0 t = f * Linf ↔ vonB Linf' K t0' (t - t0 + t0') = f * Linf') := by
  have hL := h.Linf_pos
  have hL' := h'.Linf_pos
  have hK := h.K_pos
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s
    unfold vonB
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-(K * (s - t0))), hL]
  · intro s u hsu
    unfold vonB
    have harg : -(K * (u - t0)) < -(K * (s - t0)) := by nlinarith
    nlinarith [Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr harg, hL]
  · have harg : -(K * ((t - t0 + t0') - t0')) = -(K * (t - t0)) := by ring
    unfold vonB
    rw [harg]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have h1 : 1 - Real.exp (-(K * (t - t0))) = f :=
        mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hL) (by linear_combination hx)
      rw [h1]
      ring
    · intro hx
      have h1 : 1 - Real.exp (-(K * (t - t0))) = f :=
        mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hL') (by linear_combination hx)
      rw [h1]
      ring

named_hypotheses.name: Delphi.LeanBio.Round2.GrowthAsymptote.GrowthHyp
named_hypotheses.source:
/-- Named hypothesis: a positive asymptotic length and a positive Brody coefficient. -/
structure GrowthHyp (Linf K : ℝ) : Prop where
  Linf_pos : 0 < Linf
  K_pos : 0 < K
